text: Bring pleasure back from “the territory of sin.” For centuries, many cultures and religions demonized pleasure, linking it with guilt and punishment. Right now, consciously break this neural connection in your mind. From now on, pleasure for you is what you received along with birth. Now your whole body is one continuous erogenous zone. Only the attitudes in your head previously limited it to a few points, and sometimes forbade it altogether. Now enjoyment is always with you! It is a divine gift! It is the language in which the cells of your body communicate with each other!
